entities.name: Hellenistic and Ptolemaic Cyprus

entities.summary: Alexander's conquest, the abolition of city-kingdoms by Ptolemy I, three centuries of Ptolemaic Egyptian rule, the cult of Aphrodite at Paphos, and the island's annexation by Rome.
